interface.name: zwp_virtual_keyboard_v1
interface.description:
The virtual keyboard provides an application with requests which emulate the behaviour of a physical keyboard.
This interface can be used by clients on its own to provide raw input events, or it can accompany the input method protocol.

request.name: keymap

description.summary: Provide a file descriptor to the compositor to represent the keymap

request.description:
This request provides a file descriptor to the compositor. The file descriptor represents the keymap used by the virtual keyboard. The keymap is updated by sending a new keymap request.
The keymap file descriptor must be sealed and is guaranteed to be readable for the compositor until the virtual keyboard is destroyed.

request.name: key
request.description:
A key was pressed or released. The time argument is a timestamp with millisecond granularity, with an undefined base. All requests regarding a single object must share the same clock.
Keymap format advertised by the compositor must be followed. The key is the raw keycode as delivered by the input device, and the state is the state of the key.

request.name: modifiers
request.description: Notifies the compositor that the modifier and/or group state has changed, and it should update the client's local state.

description.summary: destroy the virtual keyboard keyboard object

interface.name: zwp_virtual_keyboard_manager_v1
interface.description: A global interface used for getting the virtual keyboard interface.

request.name: create_virtual_keyboard
request.description: Create a new virtual keyboard for the given seat.

arg.name: seat
arg.summary: the wl_seat object to attach this virtual keyboard to

arg.name: id
arg.summary: the new virtual keyboard interface id
